text: Singtel holds a 24.8% equity interest in Advanced Info Service PCL (AIS): its FY2026 Annual Report says an extra 1.4% bought for S$510 million raised the interest to 24.8%, and AIS's own shareholder table (20 Aug 2026) lists Singtel Strategic Investments Pte Ltd (19.10%) plus a Singtel Strategic nominee account (5.67%).

source.name: Singtel Annual Report 2026: Financial Highlights - Significant events (Note 3)
source.quote: The Group acquired 1.4% equity interest of Advanced Info Service Public Company Limited ("AIS") for S$510 million. Following the purchase, the Group's equity interest in AIS increased to 24.8%.

additionalSources.name: Advanced Info Service PCL: Shareholder Structure (investor.ais.co.th)
additionalSources.note: Major Shareholders table 'As of 20 August 2026'; a further 5.67% (168,492,744 shares) sits in the 'Raffle Nominees (Pte) Ltd S/A Singtel Strategic Investments Pte Ltd.' account, so the Singtel vehicles together hold 24.77% of AIS shares.
